description:
Configure Odoo CRM to track subscription revenue and log a specific deal.

1. Go to Configuration > Settings and ENABLE the 'Recurring Revenues' feature. Save the settings.
2. Go to Configuration > Recurring Plans (which appears after enabling the setting) and create a new plan named 'Quarterly' with a duration of 3 Months.
3. Create a new Opportunity in the pipeline:
   - Customer: 'Apex Logic'
   - Opportunity: 'Apex Logic - Enterprise Bundle'
   - Expected Revenue (One-time): 2,500
   - Recurring Revenue: 600
   - Recurring Plan: Quarterly

Ensure all values are saved correctly.
